source.common_frame_source: same frozen Flower-clades-51 retained-tip frames used by the three-resolution profile

target_clades.rule: use only completed common-frame clades with fine_state_count > coarse_state_count

estimand.pair_universe: unordered retained-tip pairs sharing the same frozen coarse flower-color state
estimand.binary_outcome: pair shares the same frozen fine flower-color state
estimand.null: independently permute fine-state labels within each coarse-state group while preserving fine-state counts and coarse membership
estimand.primary_effect: observed conditional AUC minus mean conditional-permutation AUC
estimand.reason_for_permutation_centering: conditional null AUC need not equal 0.5 when coarse groups differ in fine-state diversity and phylogenetic distance distributions

summaries: one-sided sign test for positive clade effects

secondary_relations: hidden-memory effect versus memory-architecture scale tilt
hidden-memory effect stratified by positive versus negative global scale tilt
claim_boundary: not independent replication of the source data
within-coarse permutation isolates hierarchical organization beyond coarse membership but does not identify ecological cause
global scale tilt and hidden fine memory are not assumed to be the same quantity
